summary.en: Late-stage programmes span obesity, cardiovascular disease, autoimmune disease and oncology, alongside biosimilars. MariTide's broad phase 3 programme is a major development commitment.

gaps: No complete numerical phase-count breakdown was verified; counts is null.
The pipeline homepage returns no dynamic molecule rows; the full nine-page chart and Q3 release were reviewed instead.

Origins of ABP 206, ABP 234, MariTide and AMG 732 remain unverified. Arrowhead explicitly identifies the olpasiran license; Amgen identifies dazodalibep and daxdilimab as Horizon-acquired pipeline assets. Xaluritamig is developed under a research collaboration with Xencor.
Next is null for olpasiran, xaluritamig and AMG 732 because no specific next milestone was verified. FDA acceptance timing for ABP 234 and the daxdilimab phase 3 transition are undated.
ABP 234 is filed but awaiting FDA acceptance, so it is 'reg' under the brief's filed/under-review definition; this does not imply an accepted application.
MariTide is an antibody–peptide conjugate and dazodalibep a fusion protein, both represented as 'other'.

Approved drugs with unfiled new indications and formulation-only changes remain excluded. The 2024 proxy predates 2026-06 and is used only for acquisition provenance; current phases follow November 2026 sources.
The supplied checker rejects null phase/origin values although the research brief permits them; unsupported values are retained as null rather than invented to satisfy validation.
